title: Metric Event
description: The tagging contract on every telemetry event emitted by any subsystem. Seven required, non-null tags make every event sliceable by configuration, node, case, and seed, and reproducible. Aligned with OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions. Frozen at M0. See docs/prd/P0-foundations.md and docs/decisions/otel-genai-conventions (P0 DevOps).
$comment: schema_version is the semver of THIS event schema. The seven tags are declared here as non-null (required + typed, no null). Non-null is enforced twice more downstream: at the emission boundary (reject before write) and in Postgres (NOT NULL columns) — this schema is the first of the three layers (FR9, NFR3).

schema_version.description: Semver of the metric-event schema. Adding an optional dimension bumps MINOR; a breaking change bumps MAJOR (NFR1).

variant_id.description: TAG 1/7. Stable logical label for the variant. Low-cardinality => usable as a TSDB series label. Answers: which variant.

run_id.description: TAG 2/7. Groups one execution batch. HIGH-cardinality => NOT a TSDB series label; span attribute / Postgres column only (NFR4). Answers: which run.

node_id.description: TAG 3/7. References the static definition in the Workflow IR. Low-cardinality => usable as a TSDB series label. Answers: per-node attribution.

case_id.description: TAG 4/7. The eval case. HIGH-cardinality (~200/run) => NOT a TSDB series label; span attribute / Postgres column only (NFR4). Answers: per-case / per-failure-cluster slicing.

seed.description: TAG 5/7. The seed pinning OUR inputs (not the provider's sampling). Low-cardinality (~5) => usable as a TSDB series label. Answers: multi-seed confidence intervals.

timestamp.description: TAG 6/7. RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 UTC event time. Excluded from config_hash. Answers: trend over time.

config_hash.description: TAG 7/7. SHA-256 (hex) over the canonicalized resolved configuration (see docs/decisions/config-hash-spec.md). Low-cardinality per run => usable as a TSDB series label. Answers: which exact, replayable configuration.

metric_name.description: PAYLOAD. The measured metric (e.g. llm.latency.total_ms, llm.cost.output_usd, llm.tokens.completion). Low-cardinality dimension usable as a TSDB series label.

unit.description: PAYLOAD. Unit of value (ms, usd, tokens, count, ...). Required: a value without a unit is an incomplete payload and is rejected (FR10).

node_kind.description: OPTIONAL extensible dimension. Adding it is a MINOR bump and does not break existing consumers (FR10, NFR1).

invocation_id.description: OPTIONAL extensible dimension. HIGH-cardinality => span attribute / exemplar only, NEVER a TSDB series label (NFR4).
